entry.title: Full Range of Proxmark 3 RDV4.01 Accessories have arrived!
entry.summary:
After months of development, RRG has released its fully revised range of hardware and accessories for the Proxmark 3, including improved antennas, bluetooth and battery modules, new flashing modules and more.

More
entry.content:
After months of development, RRG has released its fully revised range of hardware and accessories for the Proxmark 3.

Proxmark 3 RDV4.01
Updated routing, improved connectivity, stabilised components and the upgraded HF & LF antennas, the RDV 4.01 is the most advanced Proxmark platform available.

Proxmark 3 "Blueshark" BLE & Battery Module
The "Blueshark" module also contains a battery, transforming your Proxmark 3 RDV4.01 and 4 into a fully-standalone pentesting device.

The Proxmark 'standalone' mode is fully supported, and the CNC'd aluminium case acts as a heatsink, further improving performance of your device.

Proxmark 3 Long Range LF Antenna Pack
There have been significant upgrades made to the LF antennas, notably the introduction of the "Q-Switch" and "F-Switches".

The F-Switch allows for targeting specific frequencies (125KHz or 134KHz), while the Q-Switch allows optimising the antenna sensitivity for specific tag types or operations.

The Low Frequency Antenna Pack contains two antennas, Standalone and Long Range, giving reading and sniffing distances up to 130mm.

Proxmark 3 Long Range HF Antenna Pack
The HF antennas have also been updated and improved, allowing for read, write and sniff operations up to

The Low Frequency Antenna Pack contains two antennas, Standalone and Long Range, giving reading and sniffing distances up to 120mm.

Proxmark 3 4.01 Antenna Upgrade Pack
If you have a Proxmark 3 RDV4, you can upgrade your existing build-in antennas easily and cheaply to the new versions.

﻿﻿We're very happy to supply our customers with the full range of high-quality accessories in the Proxmark Range. Should you have any questions, please contact us.

entry.title: Tesla S hack powered by Open Source tools
entry.summary:
The recent Tesla Model S hack is exclusively powered by Open Source hardware. Read how a Proxmark 3, Yardstick One and Raspberry Pi were used to pull of this feat.

More
entry.content:
It's been widely reported that the Tesla Model S has been successfully hacked - keyfobs can be snatched and emulated rapidly and easily.

Even more interesting is the use of 'off the shelf' hardware - a Proxmark, Yardstick one and Raspberry Pi formed the hardware backbone of the hack.
Lab401 congratulates COSIC's researchers for their hard work and responsible disclosure.
By the way - we noticed that @COSIC are using V1 Proxmarks - if you'd like to upgrade to RDV4s - send us an email!

entry.title: Proxmark 3 RDV4 Released!
entry.summary:
The Proxmark 3 RDV4 is finally available, launching simultaneously online and at DEF CON 26. For more information about this amazing device, read on!

More
entry.content:
After an incredibly successful Kickstarter campaign, the Proxmark 3 RDV4 is ready for world-wide release at DEF CON 26, and online with Lab401.

Representing the cumulation of years of hard work and expertise, the Proxmark 3 RDV4 is an entirely refreshed and miniaturised version of the RDV2, boasting a tiny footprint, new functionality, increased stability, and assertive pentesting features.

  • New: Additional 2MBit Flash Storage
  • New: SIM/SAM reader/writer
  • New: External Module Interface, for BLE/Wifi
  • New: Pre-tuned, internal antennas
  • New: Hot-swappable antennas: Medium + Long Range
  • New: External Case

  • Improved: Optimised size, now the size of a stack of 10 business cards
  • Improved: Antenna stability and performance
  • Improved: Interface: 4x Status LEDs, 4x Power LEDs

If you're attending DEF CON 26, you can pick up a Proxmark 3 RDV4 at the Hacker Warehouse stand, or you can pre-order now from Lab401.

Shipments start on August 9, the same date as DEF CON.
